fusions.name: Rolled Newspaper
fusions.desc: Swats the target for 12 damage and stuns it for 1 second. It is left 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Nick and Run
fusions.desc: Bites for 4 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Posted Orders
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 12 seconds. Enemies within 5 tiles are pulled onto you for 5 seconds, up to 4 of them.

fusions.name: Errand Runner
fusions.desc: A bonded courier hound follows you and nips enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.6 seconds. Each kill restores 3 health.
